content.text:
#MacroMemo - September 1 - 14, 2026: The report said consensus 2027 hyperscaler capex was approaching $1.1T, versus about $600B estimated at the start of 2026. It also described financing/circularity concerns and the risk that end-user demand may not justify investment commitments. (time=2026-09-01; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Buying the AI Infrastructure Dip: Morgan Stanley Research estimated the five largest U.S. technology companies' capex at about $1.2T in 2027 and $1.4T in 2028. It identified electricity availability, labor shortages, and permitting/political opposition as possible deployment constraints, while maintaining a favorable demand outlook. (time=2026-07-28; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

(time=2026-09-25T12:10:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
